subject: Urgent: GreenMosaic service impact — request for credit & exec triage
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@greenmosaic.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greg Saunders <greg.saunders@greenmosaic.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sustained latency/5xx spike impacting production — need credits & exec triage

Sergio / Laura,

We're seeing sustained elevated latency and a rise in 5xx errors across our inference pipelines since 2026-09-01 21:00 UTC. Throughput has also dropped ~30% for our peak queries; this is impacting our realtime personalization product and causing customer-facing timeouts. Attached are a sampling of error traces and a perf dump.

We have timestamps, customer incident IDs, and a rough estimate of lost revenue for the past 36 hours. Given the SLA language in our contract (section 4.2), we expect Redwood to engage executive-level support, provide a commercial credit estimate, and propose a remediation timeline.

Requesting:
- An exec triage call within 24 hours (GreenMosaic execs: Greg Saunders, Elena Park)
- Initial credit estimate and mechanics (bill offset vs. refund vs. service credit)
- Root cause hypothesis and plan of action to restore baseline throughput

Please confirm receipt. We flagged a priority support ticket (GMX-INC-1098) and attached the logs.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Platform Engineering
GreenMosaic.ai

Attachments (referenced): greenmosaic_error_samples_20260902.zip, perf_dump_2026-09-02.csv

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@greenmosaic.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sustained latency/5xx spike impacting production — need credits & exec triage

Elena — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the traces. Laura and I have visibility into the ticket. I'm elevating this to our incident response and commercial teams immediately.

Short answers up front:
- We will schedule an exec triage call within the next 12 hours (propose 16:00 PT today) — please confirm availability.
- We will run an expedited analysis to produce a provisional credit estimate by end-of-day tomorrow. That estimate will include both a measured SLA credit (per contract) and a proposed additional commercial gesture given the business impact.
- We will share a remediation timeline (short and medium term mitigations) after the initial RCA pass.

Laura, Ben — can you pull the last 72h metrics for GMX (p99 latency, 5xx rate, token throughput) and attach a quick calc for provisional credits? Ben, please include finance and legal in the thread once we have a number.

Elena — confirming the ticket GMX-INC-1098 is the right reference. I’ll send calendar invites after I hear back on the proposed time.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0128

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena.park@greenmosaic.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sustained latency/5xx spike impacting production — need credits & exec triage

Adding preliminary ops notes — pulled initial metrics and attach a CSV with throughput and error samples. Quick summary:
- P99 latency increased from 210ms to 860ms between 2026-09-01T21:10:00Z and 2026-09-02T03:40:00Z.
- 5xx rate spiked to 4.9% (baseline 0.12%).
- Token throughput capacity for the model in heavy workloads dropped ~28% during the spike window.

Initial hypothesis: intermittent KV-cache eviction storm combined with a suboptimal kernel fallback on a GPU pool that had a misapplied runtime patch during the 21:00 UTC deploy window. We're validating.

Attaching: perf_dump_2026-09-02.csv (sampled) and a short error trace set.

I propose the following immediate actions:
1) Roll back the runtime patch to the previous stable profile for your dedicated pool (will produce a short restart window).
2) Rehydrate KV-caches from durable snapshot to avoid cold cache penalty.
3) Enable temporary routing to an alternate pool in a different AZ for peak traffic (if you approve).

I'll be on the call and will present the calc for SLA credits after we confirm exact affected windows.

- Laura
Senior Ops Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena.park@greenmosaic.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greg Saunders <greg.saunders@greenmosaic.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sustained latency/5xx spike impacting production — need credits & exec triage

Thanks — the proposed rollback and routing sound sensible. We want minimal restarts and predictable behavior for our peak window tomorrow.

A couple of asks for the call:
- Please prepare a written provisional credit calculation framing options (bill offset %, fixed refund, or service credit), with the math and the affected invoice line items.
- Given the customer impact (we estimate ~120K USD potential churn exposure), we need Redwood execs on the call: Greg (our CFO) requested to participate.

We will be available for the triage call at the proposed 16:00 PT.

— Elena

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@greenmosaic.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Incident timeline and provisional commercial proposal

Folks — following the triage call, attaching a short incident timeline (incident_timeline_0903.pdf) and the first pass credit calculation (credit_calc_v1.xlsx). Summary of the proposed commercial response: 

1) Measured SLA credit: apply contract formula for affected windows (estimated 18 hours of impact across two 9-hour windows). That yields a calculated credit of ~18% of the September invoice line for inference consumption (per contract metric).
2) Goodwill commercial offer: an additional 7% bill offset for September to account for downstream business disruption and our responsibility for the runtime-fix rollback window.
3) Operational make-good: 3 months of complimentary premium support (priority SOC, 2x on-call coverage) to help with the rehydration/testing and to reduce risk of recurrence.

Net proposed outcome: 25% combined offset (18% SLA + 7% goodwill) on the September invoice, plus operational make-good. We will produce the exact $ amounts and a redline amendment for signature.

Please note — legal wants to route the amendment through DocuSign as a one-off contract side letter rather than doing a master contract amendment. Ben, Rishi: please review urgency legal considerations.

Laura

Attachments: incident_timeline_0903.pdf, credit_calc_v1.xlsx

From: Greg Saunders <greg.saunders@greenmosaic.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@greenmosaic.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident timeline and provisional commercial proposal

Appreciate the quick triage and the provisional math. Two asks from our side before we move to signature:
1) Please cap the credit calculation methodology so we understand the max exposure (we will need to brief the board if the remediation extends).
2) Given the downstream churn exposure, we want a higher goodwill component — would Redwood consider increasing the goodwill offset to 12% (for a 30% combined offset) or an option for a partial cash refund instead of the goodwill offset?

We'd like to keep the DocuSign flow but need an explicit statement on caps and an option for cash remediation if measurable revenue loss is demonstrated after a 30-day reconciliation window.

Greg Saunders
CFO, GreenMosaic.ai

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Greg Saunders <greg.saunders@greenmosaic.ai>, Elena Park <elena.park@greenmosaic.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: commercial resolution & next steps (GreenMosaic)

Greg / Elena — thanks for the direct feedback and for flagging the board briefing risk. After internal review and a short exec sync, here is Redwood's proposed final position to resolve the incident and limit executive overhead: 

1) Commercial remediation (final): apply the measured SLA credit per contract (calculated window yields 18% of the inference line for September). Add a goodwill cash-equivalent option: GreenMosaic may elect either (A) an additional 12% bill offset (delivered as a credit on the September invoice) or (B) a partial cash refund equal to 12% of the same invoice line (to be processed within 45 days of signed side letter). That yields a combined 30% remediation if you choose the cash-equivalent option.

2) Cap: Our maximum commercial exposure for this one incident is capped at 40% of the September inference spend for GreenMosaic, subject to final reconciliation and evidence of downstream revenue loss (we will include a 30-day reconciliation / audit window).

3) Operational make-good: 3 months complimentary premium support + a joint postmortem workshop (Redwood engineers + GreenMosaic platform team) with a fixed remediation timeline: patch verification + KV-cache resilience changes targeted for complete rollout within 21 days.

4) Execution: We will prepare a DocuSign side letter with the exact $ amounts and the cash-option checkbox. Ben and Rishi, please prepare the side letter and route for approvals. Elena / Greg, please confirm whether you prefer the bill offset or the cash option so we can finalize language.

I will hold the side letter for exec signature-ready by EOD 2026-09-08 if we have confirmation. If helpful, I'm happy to do one short exec touchpoint to close this out.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments (to be included with side letter): final_credit_schedule.xlsx, DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/exec/amendment/GMX-2024-014
